description: FigSuite evidence-based launch gates. A passing checklist does not deploy, enable finance transactions, or authorize payouts.

checks.title: Approve Finance-first MVP scope, official rules and no-cash boundaries
Anonymous browse and server-verified sign-in for every user mutation
Production email OTP/link, redirect allowlist, SMTP, abuse rate limits and session UAT
Own-record RLS, cross-account isolation, age/disabled-account enforcement, RBAC and operator MFA
Isolated preview/staging/production databases, credentials, migrations and rollback
Durable event catalog and forecast revisions, allocation ledger, idempotent transactions
Independent event resolution, scoring provenance and qualified rankings, with correction flow
Licensed Massive feeds, correct stale/delayed labels, market calendars and redistribution rights
Security review, secrets and dependency scanning, rate limits, audit and threat-model tests
Monitoring, alerts, backups, restore, incident response, load and recovery drills
Privacy, account deletion, accessibility, support, legal disclosure and production UX
Closed beta UAT, analytic accuracy, performance targets and launch rollback exercise
Negative prize-egress verification: no cash prizes, transfers, deposits or payout endpoints

cash_prizes.name: Cash-prize program — Independent release
cash_prizes.scope: Separate from Finance MVP; no release without independent approval

checks.title: Finance MVP gate passed and signed off independently
Event/state legal classifications, official rules, tax and jurisdiction review documented
Tremendous explicit program approval, production funding source and payout entitlement
Validated age, region, identity, tax, KYC, sanctions, and abuse eligibility controls
Fixed-award eligible entry and winner selection separated from paid simulation activity
Authoritative DB-backed approvals by two independent reviewers, non-self-approval
Funding reservation, append-only funds ledger, bounded order cap and unique award IDs
Idempotent provider worker, timeout reconciliation, webhooks, disputes and retries
Isolated provider secrets, role boundaries, kill switch, rate and amount controls
Fraud security review, audit events and monitoring for abuse and suspicious payouts
End-to-end sandbox and negative tests, funding and finance reconciliation signoff
Final founder authorization, release rollback drill and production-only change review
